import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({'name': ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E'], 'score': [72, 91, 85, 60, 91], 'team': ['x', 'y', 'x', 'y', 'x']}, index=[10, 20, 30, 40, 50])
print(len(df[df['score'] > 80]))

import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({'name': ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E'], 'score': [72, 91, 85, 60, 91], 'team': ['x', 'y', 'x', 'y', 'x']}, index=[10, 20, 30, 40, 50])
print(df[(df['score'] > 80) & (df['team'] == 'x')]['name'].tolist())
